thesis: CRCT is a real post-earnings re-rating (Q3 revenue +10.67% YoY, net income +35.74% YoY, net cash) that is consolidating in an 8.09-9.70 range above all key averages, in a sector (XLY) that is holding up. But R/R is 1.74 at the 8.62 mid entry and only about 1.30 at the 8.74 last close, under the 1.5 Hold threshold, and even the bull's 0.35 upside probability is below the roughly 0.365 breakeven, with officer selling, analyst targets near 4.73 and a risk-off tape (VIX percentile 0.981) weighing on it. Re-assess on a pullback toward 8.50 (R/R about 2.4) or a close above 9.70.
invalidation: A daily close below 8.00, under the 8.09 swing low, breaks the post-earnings base and puts the gap-fill area near 7.0 in play.
key_risks: Officer sold 70,000 shares on three straight days and plans another sale (supply overhang after the ~49% gap)
Risk-off regime: QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX 29.99 at 0.981 percentile, breadth 5 of 15 sectors
Only one quarter of re-acceleration after two down YoY quarters; forward P/E 30.5 vs trailing 19.9
Analyst mean target 4.73 far below price; downgrade or target-reset risk
Holiday-season demand read-through for consumer hardware; ATR about 5% of price
Data gaps: next earnings date unknown, SEC quarterly series incomplete
